title: Revocation of Henrique Vorcaro's arrest and the Master case
seoTitle: Henrique Vorcaro's Arrest and the Master Case
subtitle: The defense asks the Supreme Court to rule on preventive detention and the rapporteurship of the Master case
excerpt: Henrique Vorcaro, father of Daniel Vorcaro, has been held for over 90 days and seeks release as the STF has not ruled on appeals or defined the rapporteur.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Henrique Vorcaro, father of Daniel Vorcaro, has been detained for over 90 days and requested the revocation of his arrest. The defense argues that the Federal Supreme Court has not ruled on appeals against his detention and that the rapporteurship of the Master case has not yet been defined.

why the topic is trending now

The preventive detention of Henrique Vorcaro in May of this year, and its subsequent upholding by the STF in June, raised questions regarding jurisdiction to review petitions for release. The defense claimed that the STF session intended to decide whether Justice Alexandre de Moraes should be investigated failed to resolve who should lead the review. The debate over the rapporteurship of the Master case, which involves the bank and potential irregularities, is currently underway in the court.

what changes in your pocket when the Selic rate rises

Although the topic does not deal with economic policy, the discussion over the revocation of preventive detention may influence judicial decisions in high-profile cases, such as those involving major banks and public officials. Changing the rapporteur can delay or expedite the review of petitions for release, affecting the management of appeals and the progress of legal proceedings.

Fachin's role in the STF crisis

Edson Fachin, president of the STF, assumed the rapporteurship of the Master case and ordered that proceedings related to Master and the INSS case be forwarded to the Presidency, staying the proceedings while the Court discusses who should lead the investigations. Henrique Vorcaro's defense cited the lack of definition from the session that was supposed to decide on the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes and requested that Fachin review the preventive detention.

what the defense is requesting

Henrique Vorcaro's lawyers are requesting the revocation of his detention, substitution with precautionary measures, or the granting of humanitarian house arrest, citing his wife's pregnancy and the care of their two-year-old child. They also demand that the STF decide who should review the release requests and that the decision be made transparently. If forwarding the case to the Presidency does not transfer jurisdiction, the defense asks that this be expressly declared.

the impact of the impasse over rapporteurship

The standoff over who should report the Master case, which includes investigations into the bank and potential irregularities involving Justice Alexandre de Moraes, has caused delays in reviewing release petitions. The change of rapporteur, from André Mendonça to Fachin, occurred without prior requests being analyzed, leaving open who would be responsible for the decision. The defense highlights that changing the rapporteur was one of Fachin's measures to try to defuse the crisis in the Supreme Court.

With information from G1, Gazeta do Povo.
